The source left/right lobes are reflowed to upper/lower within one still-connected pinched cell. The 30 mm connecting neck is cytoplasm, not an external gap. Each of two reformed nuclei contains two separated decondensing single-DNA chromosome carriers, four in total. No spindle, plant cell plate or X-shaped duplicated chromosome is added. Every centrosome retains two separate perpendicular centriole carriers, simplified from narrow closed rods to 13 mm centreline strokes. Their 36 mm PCM circles are enlarged independently; this is a didactic layout with no physical organelle-scale claim.
